title: Donkey and Stars
statementMd:
In the evenings Donkey would join Shrek to look at the stars. They would sit on a log, sipping tea and they would watch the starry sky. The sky hung above the roof, right behind the chimney. Shrek's stars were to the right of the chimney and the Donkey's stars were to the left. Most days the Donkey would just count the stars, so he knew that they are exactly $*n*$. This time he wanted a challenge. He imagined a coordinate system: he put the origin of the coordinates at the intersection of the roof and the chimney, directed the $*OX*$ axis to the left along the roof and the $*OY*$ axis — up along the chimney (see figure). The Donkey imagined two rays emanating from he origin of axes at angles $α_{1}$ and $α_{2}$ to the $*OX*$ axis.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc47e69c0b4d9e9acb77b14506c9ec823004c0ea.png)

Now he chooses any star that lies strictly between these rays. After that he imagines more rays that emanate from this star at the same angles $α_{1}$ and $α_{2}$ to the $*OX*$ axis and chooses another star that lies strictly between the new rays. He repeats the operation as long as there still are stars he can choose between the rays that emanate from a star.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3260ce4c7c0e25f6b2f336c88f4a96dbbcf2a4c2.png)

As a result, the Donkey gets a chain of stars. He can consecutively get to each star if he acts by the given rules.

Your task is to find the maximum number of stars $*m*$ that the Donkey's chain can contain.

Note that the chain must necessarily start in the point of the origin of the axes, that isn't taken into consideration while counting the number $*m*$ of stars in the chain.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of stars. The second line contains simple fractions representing relationships "$*a*$/$*b*$ $*c*$/$*d*$", such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/447e283e0b6cfb35388504e1b8f72c174a0b3e1d.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/de46e7b6d97a5ef8bb0c6086ee8121f1da0bffc0.png) ($0 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ 10^{5}$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/254cb0ef7494ebb0abad2f2e73ab275e64cb8eb3.png); ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/45ce45f66ad28ce761b633b57d14e70d93829455.png); ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/35d78a8352f7c8821699c80d32f4cca0647a043b.png)). The given numbers $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$, $*d*$ are integers.

Next $*n*$ lines contain pairs of integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$)— the stars' coordinates.

It is guaranteed that all stars have distinct coordinates.

## Output

In a single line print number $*m*$ — the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the sample the longest chain the Donkey can build consists of four stars. Note that the Donkey can't choose the stars that lie on the rays he imagines.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9af8bf1301dfa14dc2d4206d57f9f47ac4f3922a.png)
statementZhMd:
在晚上，驴子会和史莱克一起看星星。他们坐在一根木头上，喝着茶，仰望星空。天空悬在屋顶上方，就在烟囱的后面。史莱克的星星在烟囱的右边，而驴子的星星在烟囱的左边。大多数时候，驴子只会数星星，所以他知道星星总共有 $*n*$ 颗。这一次，他想挑战一下自己。他想象出一个坐标系：将屋顶与烟囱的交点作为坐标原点，将 $*OX*$ 轴沿屋顶向左，将 $*OY*$ 轴沿烟囱向上（见下图）。驴子想象出两条从坐标原点出发的射线，它们与 $*OX*$ 轴的夹角分别为 $α_{1}$ 和 $α_{2}$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc47e69c0b4d9e9acb77b14506c9ec823004c0ea.png)

现在，他选择一颗严格位于这两条射线之间的星星。然后，他从这颗星星出发，按照与 $*OX*$ 轴夹角分别为 $α_{1}$ 和 $α_{2}$ 的相同角度想象出更多射线，并选择另一颗严格位于新射线之间的星星。只要从某颗星星出发的射线之间仍然存在可以选择的星星，他就会重复这一操作。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3260ce4c7c0e25f6b2f336c88f4a96dbbcf2a4c2.png)

最终，驴子得到了一条星星链。按照给定的规则，他可以依次到达链中的每一颗星星。

你的任务是求出驴子的星星链中最多可以包含多少颗星星 $*m*$。

注意，星星链必须从坐标原点开始，但计算链中星星数量 $*m*$ 时不计入坐标原点。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示星星的数量。第二行包含表示关系 "$*a*$/$*b*$ $*c*$/$*d*$" 的简单分数，满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/447e283e0b6cfb35388504e1b8f72c174a0b3e1d.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/de46e7b6d97a5ef8bb0c6086ee8121f1da0bffc0.png)（$0 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ 10^{5}$；![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/254cb0ef7494ebb0abad2f2e73ab275e64cb8eb3.png)；![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/45ce45f66ad28ce761b633b57d14e70d93829455.png)；![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/35d78a8352f7c8821699c80d32f4cca0647a043b.png)）。给定的 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$、$*d*$ 均为整数。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$、$*y*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$），表示星星的坐标。

保证所有星星的坐标均不相同。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出整数 $*m*$，表示问题的答案。

## 说明

在样例中，驴子能够构成的最长链包含四颗星星。注意，驴子不能选择位于他想象出的射线上的星星。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9af8bf1301dfa14dc2d4206d57f9f47ac4f3922a.png)
